# Ranging Guild

[Kandarin](kandarin.md) › Ranging Guild

The grounds inside the guild's wooden barricade (wood_wall_barricadel in map square m41_53), a diamond whose inside is |x - 2668| + |z - 3428| <= 17 with a watchtower at each tip. The guild door (2658, 3438) is in its north-west side and needs 40 Ranged (minigames/game_ranging/scripts/ranging_guild_door.rs2).
